objective: Find and independently substantiate an improvement in usable relation yield and total relation cost for Semaev index calculus on binary/Koblitz curves.
status: frozen screening protocol, not a breakthrough claim
controls: polynomial linear basis with subgroup filtering
best of a frozen 32-member random affine pool, selected by subgroup-point count only
invariant affine spaces at feasible dimension
random subgroup point sets with exactly matched sign-folded factor-base cardinality
candidate_mechanism: Increase the density of actual subgroup points inside a fixed-dimensional SAT parameter space while preserving favorable decomposition coverage.
selection_rule: Choose maximum subgroup-point count, breaking ties by candidate index. Do not select on target relations or known logarithms.
metrics: construction wall time and membership queries
actual subgroup points and sign-folded columns
coverage divided by sign-folded column count
ANF variables, equations, terms, unique nonlinear monomials and CNF size
later-stage certified SAT relations, timing, memory, independent row-rank growth
oracle_boundary: A complete subgroup logarithm table may be used only for exhaustive small-field validation and matched-null diagnostics. Its construction is separately charged and its values may not select a basis, guide a SAT solver, or be counted as an index-calculus algorithm.
falsifiers: Gain disappears after matching actual factor-base cardinality
Point-density gain is offset by construction or SAT cost
Improved root count does not improve certified relation rate or independent rank
Effect occurs only at the smallest field or a special orbit
Controls, deterministic replay, or independent certificate checks disagree
novelty: Unverified. Frobenius compression and trace-based subgroup restrictions are not claimed as new.
resource_policy: No research-time cap. Fixed trial counts define this screen, not the persistent goal. Process failures are operational outcomes, not mathematical results.
breakthrough_gate: No completion or breakthrough claim without a precise new mechanism, cost-correct cross-scale advantage, literature comparison, independent adversarial review, and end-to-end usable relation/rank evidence. This screen alone cannot discharge the gate.
next_action_after_screen: Choose the next SAT-encoding or factor-base construction experiment using the complete screen, retaining all failed and null outcomes.
